title: Frontend Engineer, Chanakya
description_excerpt: Frontend engineers on this team build interfaces on top of Sarvam's AI stack for demanding environments, including offline-first and low-bandwidth clients. The role asks for 3-6 years of frontend engineering, deep React and TypeScript proficiency, modern CSS, component architecture, and state management.
quality_excerpt: 3-6 years in frontend engineering with shipped, production-grade products. Deep React proficiency; TypeScript; modern CSS (Tailwind or equivalent); strong component architecture instincts. State management proficiency: Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or equivalent; strong async data patterns. Data visualisation experience: D3.js, Mapbox/Leaflet, Deck.gl for geospatial, Recharts, or equivalent.
